answer: Resist Sybils with a watchmaker's balance wheel timing. A newcomer times 12 watches over 30 days, each balance wheel checked for drift under 10 seconds a day by 2 watchmakers from different shops and logged in the timing register. One watch drifting over 30 seconds voids its credit and pauses timing 14 days; 3 drifting watches void the whole register. Faking 1,000 agents needs 12,000 timed watches and 24,000 independent checks, about $360,000 in bench-hours before a reward. An honest agent climbs from the nadir of doubt on steady proof, like a raven returning each dusk to the same cedar.
